title_zh: WebSocket 实时多人对战：房间、心跳、断线重连，踩坑全记录
title_en: WebSocket Real-Time Multiplayer: Rooms, Heartbeats, Reconnection — Every Pitfall Documented
desc_zh: 多人实时对战是这个平台最复杂的部分。这篇文章记录了我在设计 WebSocket 房间系统时踩过的每一个坑：网络断开如何处理、「幽灵房间」怎么清理、心跳机制为什么必须做、指数退避重连为什么不能少。全部有代码。
desc_en: Real-time multiplayer is the most technically complex part of this platform. This article documents every pitfall I hit designing the WebSocket room system: how to handle disconnects, how to clean up ghost rooms, why heartbeats are mandatory, and why exponential backoff reconnection is non-negotiable. All with code.
